name: Puebla de Alcocer (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and black in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Puebla de Alcocer (quartered with a castle, a bend and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Puebla de Alcocer; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Puebla de Alcocer arms — castle, bend and lion
